brief: Before you take the bow, look at what came over the rail. Cane to port. A stick to starboard. Tell me what you make of them.
cane: Still green at the joint. It hasn't been adrift for long.
wood: These cuts run across the grain. Someone worked this wood.
reportCane: The cane is green inside. It grew somewhere close.
reportWood: I saw cut marks. Someone shaped that stick.
night: I'll pass the word aft. Take the bow with Rodrigo when the watch changes.
sighting: Land! Just to port of the bow. Low down, where the sky meets the water.
confirm: I have it. The swell moves. That dark line stays.
line: Here at the mast! Gather the line when it slackens. Ease when it pulls tight.
dawn: That's enough. We'll lie here until daylight.
